objective: Resolver exclusivamente los contratos fisicos pendientes antes de convertir la propuesta DDL de Cavas Corporativas en migracion ejecutable: entidad/llave de organizacion cliente B2B, tipo y llave de unidad de negocio, identificadores canonicos de linea/categoria/familia/SKU y objetos/llaves canonicas de reservas/tickets/consumos. Solo metadata y muestras no sensibles; sin DDL/DML, sin secretos y sin Production.

queries.name: ddl_contract_organizations
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (o.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Organiz%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR o.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR o.name LIKE '%Corporat%' OR o.name LIKE '%Contacto%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: ddl_contract_units
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=o.object_id AND ic.column_id=c.column_id LEFT JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=ic.object_id AND i.index_id=ic.index_id WHERE o.type='U' AND o.name='Unidades_Negocio' ORDER BY c.column_id,i.is_primary_key DESC,i.is_unique DESC

queries.name: ddl_contract_product_hierarchy
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 250 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (o.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Articulo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR o.name LIKE '%Familia%' OR o.name LIKE '%Grupo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Linea%') AND (c.name LIKE '%ID%' OR c.name LIKE '%Codigo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Clave%' OR c.name LIKE '%Nombre%' OR c.name LIKE '%Categoria%' OR c.name LIKE '%Familia%' OR c.name LIKE '%Grupo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Linea%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: ddl_contract_operations
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 250 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (o.name LIKE '%Reserva%' OR o.name LIKE '%Mesa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR o.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR o.name LIKE '%Consumo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Comanda%') AND (c.name LIKE '%ID%' OR c.name LIKE '%Folio%' OR c.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cuenta%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Sucursal%' OR c.name LIKE '%Origen%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: ddl_contract_external_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 250 schp.name AS parent_schema,tp.name AS parent_table,cp.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,schr.name AS referenced_schema,tr.name AS referenced_table,cr.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables tp ON tp.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schp ON schp.schema_id=tp.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cp ON cp.object_id=tp.object_id AND cp.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables tr ON tr.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas schr ON schr.schema_id=tr.schema_id JOIN sys.columns cr ON cr.object_id=tr.object_id AND cr.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE tp.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_Empresas') OR tr.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_Empresas') OR tp.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR tp.name LIKE '%Reserva%' OR tr.name LIKE '%Reserva%' ORDER BY schp.name,tp.name,fk.name
